data.name: Allows you to retrieve a specific employee used in Xero payrun
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves one employee resource associated with a Xero payrun using its employee identifier. Use the response to inspect that employee's payroll record.
Use for: retrieve an employee, inspect payrun employee data, look up an employee by ID
Not supported: employee creation, employee updates, payrun submission

data.name: 従業員の基本給の更新
data.description:
概要

指定した従業員の基本給情報を更新します。

注意点

  • 管理者権限を持ったユーザーのみ実行可能です。
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates the specified employee's base salary information in freee HR. It is limited to users with administrator permissions.
Use for: update base salary, change an employee pay rule, revise salary details
Not supported: employee retrieval, bonus updates, non-administrator execution

data.name: 年末調整従業員給与・賞与の更新
data.description:
概要

指定した従業員の給与・賞与を更新します。

注意点

  • 本APIは、年末調整が確定済みの従業員には非対応です。
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates an employee's salary and bonus information for a specified year-end adjustment. It does not support employees whose adjustment is already finalized.
Use for: update annual salary, revise bonus details, edit year-end adjustment pay
Not supported: finalized adjustments, employee creation, base pay rule updates

data.name: TableBuilderCode
data.description: Retrieves employee pay rate information based on the specified PayrateId.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves employee pay rate information through a company-specific lookup resource, using a specified pay rate identifier and query filters.
Use for: look up a pay rate, inspect pay rate details, filter rate information
Not supported: pay rate creation, pay rate updates, employee profile retrieval

data.name: Get a collection of pay rates
data.description: Retrieves a list of employee pay rate details based on the specified company_id.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a list of employee pay rate details for a specified company, with sorting, pagination, counting, and filtering controls.
Use for: list pay rates, filter employee rates, paginate rate results, sort pay rates
Not supported: single-record lookup, pay rate creation, pay rate updates

data.name: Get a single pay rate record
data.description: Retrieves employee pay rate information based on the specified PayrateId.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves one employee pay rate record for a specified company using its pay rate identifier.
Use for: retrieve a pay rate, inspect one rate record, look up a rate by ID
Not supported: pay rate listing, pay rate creation, pay rate updates
